Business Term.Name: Customer ID
Business Term.Description: Unique enterprise identifier assigned to a customer record (individual or organization) used to link all customer-related transactions across systems.
Business Term.Business Logic: System-generated persistent identifier; immutable once assigned; used as primary foreign key in related domain records.
Business Term.Format Description: Alphanumeric string, enterprise namespace prefix followed by numeric sequence

Business Term.Name: Customer Legal Entity Name
Business Term.Description: Official legal name of the customer for contractual and regulatory purposes. For individuals, this is first/middle/last name; for organizations, the registered business name.
Business Term.Business Logic: Stored as primary name field; used on legal documents, policies and invoices; normalized according to legal-name formatting rules.
Business Term.Examples: Acme Insurance Brokers Ltd; Maria Anne Garcia
Business Term.Format Description: Free text with legal name character rules

Business Term.Name: Customer Type
Business Term.Description: Classification of customer as Individual, Organization, Trust, or Government entity for product eligibility, tax and regulatory treatment.
Business Term.Business Logic: Assigned at customer creation and validated against KYC and jurisdictional rules; used to control available products and required documentation.

Business Term.Name: Primary Contact Email
Business Term.Description: Primary email address for customer communications, notices and electronic delivery of documents.
Business Term.Business Logic: Validated by format and optionally verified via confirmation workflow; used for e-delivery and regulatory notices.

Business Term.Name: Customer Date of Birth
Business Term.Description: Date of birth for individual customers used for underwriting, pricing, and age-related regulatory checks.
Business Term.Business Logic: Stored as date; required for individuals; used to calculate age on policy effective date for eligibility and pricing.

Business Term.Name: Customer Address (Primary)
Business Term.Description: Primary physical address for the customer used for service of notices, underwriting exposure location, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
Business Term.Business Logic: Structured address record (street, city, postal code, country); used to determine product availability, taxes and risk exposures.
Business Term.Format Description: Structured multi-field address stored as concatenated text for display

Business Term.Name: Customer Tax Identifier
Business Term.Description: Official tax identification number for the customer used for tax reporting and regulatory compliance (e.g., SSN, TIN, VAT number).
Business Term.Business Logic: Captured per jurisdiction; format validated against country rules; access restricted; required for premium tax reporting where applicable.

Business Term.Name: Customer Relationship Start Date
Business Term.Description: Date when the enterprise first established a relationship with the customer (e.g., first policy effective date, first invoice date).
Business Term.Business Logic: Set at first transactional interaction; used for tenure calculations, loyalty programs and regulatory record retention schedules.

Business Term.Name: Customer Risk Profile
Business Term.Description: Enterprise-assigned categorical assessment of a customer's overall risk (e.g., Low/Medium/High) combining underwriting, credit and fraud indicators.
Business Term.Business Logic: Derived from underwriting score, claims history, credit checks and fraud flags according to documented scoring algorithm; updated on major events.
Business Term.Format Description: Enumerated category derived from scoring model

Business Term.Name: Policy Number
Business Term.Description: Unique identifier assigned to an insurance policy used to reference policy terms, coverage and transactions.
Business Term.Business Logic: System-generated unique code per policy contract; immutable and used as primary key for policy administration records.
Business Term.Format Description: Alphanumeric identifier with enterprise policy numbering scheme

Business Term.Name: Policy Type
Business Term.Description: Classification of the insurance policy by line of business and product (e.g., Personal Auto, Commercial Property, Life Term).
Business Term.Business Logic: Assigned at policy issuance based on product code; controls applicable rules, rates and regulatory reporting.

Business Term.Name: Policy Effective Date
Business Term.Description: Date and time when policy coverage begins.
Business Term.Business Logic: Defined on policy issuance or endorsement; used to determine coverage applicability and pricing period; time zone must be recorded for cross-border policies.

Business Term.Name: Policy Expiration Date
Business Term.Description: Date when the policy coverage terminates unless renewed or extended by endorsement.
Business Term.Business Logic: Calculated from effective date plus term length or set explicitly; triggers renewal and non-renewal workflows.

Business Term.Name: Policy Status
Business Term.Description: Current administrative state of the policy reflecting lifecycle stage such as Draft, Active, Lapsed, Cancelled, Renewed, Pending.
Business Term.Business Logic: State machine updated by transactions (issue, cancel, lapse, renew, endorse); each status transition must be auditable with timestamp and actor.

Business Term.Name: Named Insured Reference
Business Term.Description: Reference to the Customer ID representing the party named on the policy as the insured.
Business Term.Business Logic: Foreign key link to Customer ID; multiple named insureds allowed via separate references; used for claims and billing routing.

Business Term.Name: Coverage Limit
Business Term.Description: Maximum monetary amount that the insurer will pay for a covered loss under the policy or coverage section.
Business Term.Business Logic: Defined per coverage section; may be aggregate or occurrence-based; used to calculate exposure and reserve ceilings.
Business Term.Format Description: Monetary decimal with two decimal places (enterprise currency implied)

Business Term.Name: Policy Premium Amount
Business Term.Description: Total premium charged for the policy for the defined term before taxes, fees and commissions.
Business Term.Business Logic: Sum of all rated premium components for the policy term; used on billing/invoice generation and financial recognition.

Business Term.Name: Endorsement Record
Business Term.Description: Documented change to policy coverage, limits, premium or terms after original issuance; each endorsement has its own identifier and effective date.
Business Term.Business Logic: Stored as transaction linked to Policy Number; includes endorsement ID, effective date, delta changes and reason; impacts premium and coverage calculations.

Business Term.Name: Application ID
Business Term.Description: Unique identifier for an insurance application submitted for underwriting review.
Business Term.Business Logic: Assigned at receipt of application; links to applicant Customer ID and to resulting Policy Number upon issuance or to declination record.

Business Term.Name: Underwriting Decision
Business Term.Description: Outcome of underwriting evaluation: Accept, Accept with Conditions, Refer, Decline, or Pending.
Business Term.Business Logic: Recorded with rationale and effective date; decision must reference applicable guidelines and any required endorsements or exclusions.
Business Term.Examples: Accept with Conditions (exclusion for specified peril)
Business Term.Format Description: Enumerated outcome with optional free-text rationale

Business Term.Name: Underwriting Score
Business Term.Description: Numeric score produced by underwriting models representing suitability/ risk of the application.
Business Term.Business Logic: Calculated by underwriting model combining risk factors (age, property characteristics, claims history); higher values represent higher risk per model definition; stored with model version.
Business Term.Format Description: Integer or decimal per model specification

Business Term.Name: Declared Value
Business Term.Description: Customer-declared monetary value of insured property or sum insured for valuation and premium calculation.
Business Term.Business Logic: Captured per coverage item; validated against valuation rules and used to determine coverage limits and premium.

Business Term.Name: Risk Class
Business Term.Description: Underwriting classification grouping that determines pricing cohort and acceptance rules (e.g., Preferred, Standard, Substandard).
Business Term.Business Logic: Assigned based on underwriting score and rule thresholds; used to select rating factors and eligibility.

Business Term.Name: Underwriting Guideline Reference
Business Term.Description: Identifier for the specific underwriting guideline, rule or policy document referenced in the decision.
Business Term.Business Logic: Recorded on every decision to ensure traceability; must include version and effective date of the guideline.

Business Term.Name: Underwriting Effective Date
Business Term.Description: Date when the underwriting decision takes effect (e.g., policy effective date when accepted).
Business Term.Business Logic: Set to policy effective date for accepted applications or to decision date for declinations; used for audit and reporting.

Business Term.Name: Claim Number
Business Term.Description: Unique identifier assigned to an insurance claim used to track events, payments and reserves.
Business Term.Business Logic: System-generated unique code assigned at first notice of loss (FNOL); used as primary key for claim transactions and correspondence.

Business Term.Name: Date of Loss
Business Term.Description: Date when the insured event occurred that gave rise to the claim.
Business Term.Business Logic: Captured from claimant or investigative sources; used to determine coverage applicability and statute of limitations triggers.

Business Term.Name: Claim Notice Date
Business Term.Description: Date the insurer received notification of the claim (FNOL date).
Business Term.Business Logic: Recorded at first contact and used to calculate claim reporting timelines, reserves set and regulatory reporting deadlines.

Business Term.Name: Claim Status
Business Term.Description: Administrative state of the claim such as Open, Active Investigation, Reserved, Paid, Denied, Closed, Reopened.
Business Term.Business Logic: Updated by defined claim lifecycle events; transitions must be auditable and associated with user/actor and timestamp.

Business Term.Name: Claim Reserve Amount
Business Term.Description: Amount set aside by the insurer representing an estimate of future payments for the claim.
Business Term.Business Logic: Recorded monetary estimate; updated as assessment evolves; should be granular by reserve type (case, IBNR managed separately) and currency.

Business Term.Name: Paid Loss Amount
Business Term.Description: Total monetary amount paid to date on the claim including indemnity and related expenses.
Business Term.Business Logic: Sum of all payment transactions applied to the Claim Number; excludes recoveries which are recorded separately.

Business Term.Name: Claimant Reference
Business Term.Description: Reference to the party making the claim (could be customer or third party) linked to Customer ID if available.
Business Term.Business Logic: Links to Customer ID when claimant is a known customer; otherwise stores external claimant identifier; used for payments and recovery actions.
Business Term.Format Description: Customer ID or external claimant identifier

Business Term.Name: Subrogation Indicator
Business Term.Description: Boolean flag indicating whether subrogation or recovery against a third party is applicable or pursued for the claim.
Business Term.Business Logic: Set during claim assessment; if true, attach subrogation case reference and expected recoverable amount.

Business Term.Name: Coverage Applicability Determination
Business Term.Description: Outcome of coverage assessment indicating whether the claimed loss is covered under the policy terms (Covered, Partially Covered, Excluded).
Business Term.Business Logic: Documented with rationale and policy references; used to authorize payments and determine denial or reservation amounts.
Business Term.Format Description: Enumerated outcome with free text rationale

Business Term.Name: Invoice ID
Business Term.Description: Unique identifier for a billing invoice sent to a customer for premiums, fees or other charges.
Business Term.Business Logic: Generated per billing event; links to Policy Number, billing period, and payment transactions until settled or written off.

Business Term.Name: Invoice Date
Business Term.Description: Date the invoice was issued to the customer.
Business Term.Business Logic: Used to calculate payment due dates, aging and recognition of receivables.

Business Term.Name: Billing Due Date
Business Term.Description: Date by which the invoiced amount must be paid to avoid late fees, policy cancellation or penalties.
Business Term.Business Logic: Calculated from invoice date and payment terms; triggers reminders and collections workflows when past due.

Business Term.Name: Premium Due Amount
Business Term.Description: Monetary amount due for premiums on the invoice excluding taxes and fees.
Business Term.Business Logic: Derived from Policy Premium Amount apportioned to billing installment or full-term invoice; reflect endorsements/adjustments.

Business Term.Name: Payment Transaction ID
Business Term.Description: Unique identifier for a payment event applied to an invoice or policy (could be partial or full).
Business Term.Business Logic: Generated by payment processing system; links to Invoice ID, payment method, amount and settlement date.

Business Term.Name: Payment Method
Business Term.Description: Mechanism used to remit payment such as Credit Card, Bank Transfer, Direct Debit, Cheque, or Electronic Wallet.
Business Term.Business Logic: Captured at payment initiation; determines processing fees, settlement timelines and refund handling.

Business Term.Name: Billing Status
Business Term.Description: State of the invoice or billing account: Outstanding, Paid, Partially Paid, Overdue, Written Off.
Business Term.Business Logic: Updated by payment events and collections processes; used to trigger policy actions (e.g., cancellation on non-payment).

Business Term.Name: Installment Plan Indicator
Business Term.Description: Flag indicating whether the premium is payable via scheduled installments and details of installment schedule identifier.
Business Term.Business Logic: If true, link to installment schedule with due dates and amounts; affects billing generation and dunning logic.
Business Term.Format Description: Boolean as text with schedule reference

Business Term.Name: Producer ID
Business Term.Description: Unique identifier for distribution partners including agents, brokers and intermediaries active with the enterprise.
Business Term.Business Logic: Assigned on appointment; links to contracts, commission records, and sales credited; includes classification of agent type and licensing details externally.

Business Term.Name: Distribution Channel
Business Term.Description: Primary route to market for business such as Direct, Broker, Bancassurance, Affinity, or Online.
Business Term.Business Logic: Assigned at point of sale and recorded on policy and application; used for performance reporting, commission rules and product eligibility.

Business Term.Name: Commission Rate
Business Term.Description: Percentage rate or schedule used to calculate commission payable to the producer for a sale or renewal.
Business Term.Business Logic: Applied to written premium or net premium per contractual terms; may vary by product, channel and lifecycle event (new business vs renewal).

Business Term.Name: Commission Payable Amount
Business Term.Description: Monetary amount owed to the producer for commissions on written or renewed business before tax and adjustments.
Business Term.Business Logic: Calculated as Commission Rate * applicable premium base minus chargebacks and adjustments; disbursed per payment schedule.

Business Term.Name: Producer Appointment Effective Date
Business Term.Description: Date the producer is authorized to represent the insurer under contract.
Business Term.Business Logic: Recorded when contract countersigned; used to validate transactions credited to producer and commission eligibility.

Business Term.Name: Appointment Status
Business Term.Description: Current status of the producer's authorization such as Active, Suspended, Terminated, Pending Approval.
Business Term.Business Logic: Updated by HR/Distribution operations and compliance checks; suspension affects ability to write new business.

Business Term.Name: Enterprise Risk Category
Business Term.Description: High-level classification of risk exposures (e.g., Underwriting Risk, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operational Risk, Liquidity Risk, Model Risk).
Business Term.Business Logic: Assigned to exposures, events and controls to enable aggregated risk reporting and align to risk appetite framework.

Business Term.Name: Exposure Amount
Business Term.Description: Monetary value representing the insurer's potential financial exposure to loss for a defined aggregation (policy, portfolio, peril, event).
Business Term.Business Logic: Calculated per aggregation rules (e.g., sum insured, coverage limits, aggregate attachments); used in capital and limit calculations.

Business Term.Name: Catastrophe Exposure
Business Term.Description: Quantified exposure for modeled catastrophe perils (e.g., earthquake, flood, hurricane) for specified geographic aggregation and return period.
Business Term.Business Logic: Derived from exposure mapping to vulnerability models and event footprints; stored by peril, region and modeled return period.

Business Term.Name: Risk Mitigation Measure
Business Term.Description: Specific control, transfer, reduction or acceptance action applied to reduce identified risk (e.g., reinsurance purchase, underwriting restrictions).
Business Term.Business Logic: Recorded with expected impact, implementation date and owner; linked to the exposure or policy segment it addresses.
Business Term.Examples: Purchase quota share treaty covering 30% of commercial property portfolio
Business Term.Format Description: Free text with structured fields for type and owner

Business Term.Name: Model Version
Business Term.Description: Identifier and version of the risk model used for calculating scores, exposures, capital metrics or pricing assumptions.
Business Term.Business Logic: Recorded with provenance, input data snapshot and validation results; every metric derived from a model must reference Model Version.

Business Term.Name: Product Code
Business Term.Description: Unique enterprise code identifying an insurance product offering used for quoting, rating and policy lifecycle.
Business Term.Business Logic: Assigned by product management; used to bind product-specific rating algorithms, coverage templates and regulatory mappings.

Business Term.Name: Product Name
Business Term.Description: Human-readable name of the insurance product used in customer communications and documentation.
Business Term.Business Logic: Mapped to Product Code; must match documentation and marketing collateral; used in policy documents and system displays.

Business Term.Name: Product Coverage Description
Business Term.Description: Detailed description of coverages, exclusions, limits, sublimits and conditions that define the product.
Business Term.Business Logic: Maintained by product management; referenced during claims coverage determination and in policy documentation.
Business Term.Examples: Covers physical damage, theft, and third-party liability subject to per-occurrence limits.
Business Term.Format Description: Structured free text including coverage sections

Business Term.Name: Rating Algorithm Version
Business Term.Description: Identifier for the version of the rating engine or algorithm used to calculate premiums for the product.
Business Term.Business Logic: Recorded with effective date; each premium calculation must reference the rating algorithm version and parameter tariff snapshot.

Business Term.Name: Minimum Premium
Business Term.Description: Minimum allowable premium for the product or policy irrespective of calculated premium.
Business Term.Business Logic: Applied after rating calculations; ensures business and profitability constraints; may vary by territory and distribution channel.

Business Term.Name: Product Territory
Business Term.Description: Geographic scope where the product is offered and valid (by country, state/province or region) with regulatory constraints.
Business Term.Business Logic: Determines product availability, taxation, and jurisdiction-specific wording; enforced at quoting and issuance.
Business Term.Format Description: Enumerated geographic values or free text for regions

Business Term.Name: Reinsurance Treaty ID
Business Term.Description: Unique identifier for a reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which reinsurance cover is provided.
Business Term.Business Logic: Assigned by reinsurance management; links ceded premium, ceding percentage, coverage period and reinsurer details.

Business Term.Name: Reinsurer ID
Business Term.Description: Unique identifier for a reinsurer counterparty.
Business Term.Business Logic: Linked to counterparty master data including credit ratings and jurisdiction; used in recoverables and placement records.

Business Term.Name: Ceding Percentage
Business Term.Description: Portion of risk or premium ceded to the reinsurer under the treaty, expressed as a percentage.
Business Term.Business Logic: Applied to exposure, premium and losses per treaty terms to calculate ceded premium and recoverables; distinct from quota-share share calculations.

Business Term.Name: Reinsurance Premium Ceded
Business Term.Description: Monetary premium amount transferred to reinsurer for coverage provided under the treaty.
Business Term.Business Logic: Calculated as applicable portion of written premium per treaty terms (e.g., ceding percentage * written premium) and accounting adjustments.

Business Term.Name: Reinsurance Recoverable Amount
Business Term.Description: Amount expected to be recovered from the reinsurer for paid losses and outstanding reserves under the treaty.
Business Term.Business Logic: Calculated per claim and treaty terms: ceded share of paid losses and reserves less recoverability provisions and timing/credit adjustments.

Business Term.Name: Retrocession Indicator
Business Term.Description: Flag indicating whether the treaty or portion thereof is retroceded to another reinsurer.
Business Term.Business Logic: Set when reinsurance itself is reinsured; links to retrocession treaty records and affects net exposure calculations.

Business Term.Name: Regulatory Filing ID
Business Term.Description: Unique identifier for a regulatory filing submitted to an authority (statutory return, tax filing, solvency report).
Business Term.Business Logic: Assigned per filing; links to filing type, reporting period, submission date and jurisdiction; auditable trail required.

Business Term.Name: Filing Type
Business Term.Description: Category of submission required by regulator such as Solvency, Statutory Financials, Tax Return, Consumer Disclosure, or Data Privacy Report.
Business Term.Business Logic: Used to determine content templates, submission frequency and responsible owners; filed per jurisdiction rules.

Business Term.Name: Reporting Period
Business Term.Description: Time period covered by a regulatory filing or compliance report (e.g., Q1 2025, FY 2024).
Business Term.Business Logic: Defined per filing type and jurisdiction; used to scope source data extraction and reconciliation.
Business Term.Format Description: Date range represented as text or structured start/end dates

Business Term.Name: Regulatory Status
Business Term.Description: Status of regulatory interactions such as Filed, Accepted, Rejected, Under Review, Remediated, or Outstanding Action.
Business Term.Business Logic: Updated per regulator communication; must include timestamp and responsible owner for remediation items.

Business Term.Name: Materiality Assessment
Business Term.Description: Enterprise-documented assessment identifying whether an issue or misstatement is material for financial reporting or regulatory compliance.
Business Term.Business Logic: Applied using prescribed thresholds and qualitative factors; outcome documented and used to determine disclosure and remediation actions.
Business Term.Examples: Material due to aggregate effect on solvency ratio
Business Term.Format Description: Free text with categorical result (Material / Not Material)

Business Term.Name: Consent Record
Business Term.Description: Record of customer consent for data processing, purpose, scope, date/time and revocation status required under privacy laws.
Business Term.Business Logic: Captured at customer interaction; includes consent type, expiration, mechanism and audit trail; must be checked prior to processing personal data for the consented purpose.
Business Term.Examples: Marketing Consent: granted on 2024-09-10 via web form
Business Term.Format Description: Structured text with consent attributes (type, timestamp, source, status)

Business Term.Name: Data Subject Access Request Record
Business Term.Description: Record capturing a data subject's request (access, rectification, erasure, portability) and the enterprise's handling and resolution.
Business Term.Business Logic: Includes request type, received date, due date per regulation, actions taken, and closure date; used for compliance reporting and audit.
Business Term.Format Description: Structured text with dates and status

Metric.Name: Active Customer Count
Metric.Description: Number of customers with at least one in-force policy or active service relationship during the measurement period.
Metric.Business Logic: Count distinct Customer ID where there exists at least one policy with Policy Status = Active or an open service contract within the period.

Metric.Name: Customer Retention Rate
Metric.Description: Percentage of customers retained from the beginning to the end of a specified period measured by continued policy or service existence.
Metric.Business Logic: (Number of customers at period end who were customers at period start and have at least one active policy) / (Number of customers at period start) * 100.

Metric.Name: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)
Metric.Description: Projected net present value of future profits attributable to a customer relationship over its expected lifetime.
Metric.Business Logic: Sum of expected future premium revenue minus expected claims, acquisition and servicing costs, discounted to present value using enterprise discount rate; segmented by product mix.
Metric.Format Description: Currency decimal to two places (enterprise currency context required)

Metric.Name: Policies In Force Count
Metric.Description: Number of policies with Policy Status = Active at a point in time.
Metric.Business Logic: Count distinct Policy Number where Policy Status equals Active as of measurement timestamp.

Metric.Name: Policy Lapse Rate
Metric.Description: Percentage of policies that lapsed (expired without renewal or whose premium was unpaid) during the period.
Metric.Business Logic: (Number of policies that moved to Lapsed status during period) / (Number of policies in force at period start) * 100.

Metric.Name: Average Premium Per Policy
Metric.Description: Mean premium amount across all in-force policies for the measurement period.
Metric.Business Logic: Sum of Policy Premium Amount for in-force policies divided by Policies In Force Count.

Metric.Name: New Business Hit Ratio
Metric.Description: Proportion of submitted applications that result in an accepted policy (including accept with conditions).
Metric.Business Logic: (Number of Application ID with Underwriting Decision in {Accept, Accept with Conditions} during period) / (Total Application ID submitted during period) * 100.

Metric.Name: Average Underwriting Turnaround Time
Metric.Description: Average time elapsed between application submission and final underwriting decision.
Metric.Business Logic: Average of (Underwriting Effective Date - Application Submission Date) in calendar days for applications with a final decision during the period.
Metric.Format Description: Decimal representing days to one decimal place

Metric.Name: Average Claim Cycle Time
Metric.Description: Average elapsed time between Claim Notice Date and claim closure (final settlement or denial).
Metric.Business Logic: Average of (Claim Closure Date - Claim Notice Date) in calendar days for claims closed during the period.
Metric.Format Description: Decimal representing days with one decimal place

Metric.Name: Claims Frequency per 1,000 Policies
Metric.Description: Number of claims reported during period normalized to 1,000 in-force policies.
Metric.Business Logic: (Number of Claim Number with Claim Notice Date in period) / (Policies In Force Count during period) * 1,000.

Metric.Name: Loss Ratio
Metric.Description: Measure of underwriting performance defined as (incurred losses + allocated loss adjustment expenses) divided by earned premium for the period.
Metric.Business Logic: (Sum of Paid Loss Amount + change in Claim Reserve Amount + allocated LAE for period) / Earned Premium for same period * 100.

Metric.Name: Premium Collection Rate
Metric.Description: Percentage of billed premium collected within the measurement period.
Metric.Business Logic: (Sum of Payment Transaction amounts applied to premium for invoices issued in period) / (Sum of Premium Due Amount for invoices issued in period) * 100.

Metric.Name: Days Sales Outstanding for Premiums
Metric.Description: Average number of days between invoice date and receipt of payment for premium invoices.
Metric.Business Logic: Average of (Payment Date - Invoice Date) in calendar days for payments received during the period; exclude write-offs and refunds.
Metric.Format Description: Decimal representing days with one decimal place

Metric.Name: Payment Failure Rate
Metric.Description: Percentage of payment attempts that failed (e.g., insufficient funds, declined card) in the period.
Metric.Business Logic: (Number of failed payment transactions in period) / (Total payment attempts in period) * 100.

Metric.Name: New Business Written by Channel
Metric.Description: Total written premium for new business policies issued in the period, broken down by Distribution Channel.
Metric.Business Logic: Sum of Policy Premium Amount for policies with policy effective date in period and tagged as New Business, aggregated by Distribution Channel.

Metric.Name: Commission Ratio by Channel
Metric.Description: Ratio of commission payable to written premium for a distribution channel during the period.
Metric.Business Logic: (Sum of Commission Payable Amount for channel in period) / (Sum of written premium for channel in period) * 100.

Metric.Name: Producer Conversion Rate
Metric.Description: Percentage of quotes or applications submitted via a producer that convert to issued policies.
Metric.Business Logic: (Number of policies issued credited to Producer ID during period) / (Number of quotes or applications submitted by Producer ID during period) * 100.

Metric.Name: Value at Risk (VaR) - Insurance Portfolio
Metric.Description: Monetary estimate of maximum loss over a defined time horizon at a specified confidence level for the insurance portfolio.
Metric.Business Logic: Calculated using enterprise-approved model over defined horizon (e.g., one-year) at specified confidence (e.g., 99.5%); requires model version and scenario inputs.
Metric.Format Description: Currency decimal with model and confidence metadata

Metric.Name: Expected Loss
Metric.Description: Projected average loss amount for a portfolio over a defined period based on historical loss rates and exposure.
Metric.Business Logic: Sum over portfolio of (expected frequency * expected severity) by exposure unit, aggregated to monetary value for reporting period.

Metric.Name: Tail Risk Measure (e.g., 99.5% VaR)
Metric.Description: Quantitative metric describing extreme loss potential in the tail of the distribution at enterprise-specified confidence levels.
Metric.Business Logic: Calculated using approved stochastic or scenario models; requires specification of confidence level and model version.

Metric.Name: In-force Premium by Product
Metric.Description: Total premium amount in force aggregated by product code at a point in time.
Metric.Business Logic: Sum of Policy Premium Amount for policies with Policy Status = Active filtered by Product Code as of measurement date.

Metric.Name: Product Profitability (Loss Ratio by Product)
Metric.Description: Loss ratio calculated specifically for a product (incurred losses and allocated LAE / earned premium for the product).
Metric.Business Logic: (Sum of incurred losses + allocated LAE attributable to Product Code during period) / (Earned Premium for Product Code during period) * 100.

Metric.Name: Product Cancellation Rate
Metric.Description: Percentage of policies for a product that were cancelled during the period relative to policies in force at period start.
Metric.Business Logic: (Number of policies with Policy Status changing to Cancelled during period and Product Code = X) / (Policies In Force for product at period start) * 100.

Metric.Name: Ceded Premium Ratio
Metric.Description: Percentage of written premium ceded to reinsurers for the period.
Metric.Business Logic: (Sum of Reinsurance Premium Ceded during period) / (Sum of Written Premium during period) * 100.

Metric.Name: Reinsurance Recoverable Outstanding
Metric.Description: Total unpaid amount expected from reinsurers for ceded claims and reserves at measurement date.
Metric.Business Logic: Sum of Reinsurance Recoverable Amount across claims and reserves less amounts already received from reinsurers.

Metric.Name: Reinsurance Coverage Limit Utilization
Metric.Description: Percentage of reinsurance limit consumed by current and expected ceded losses for a treaty.
Metric.Business Logic: (Sum of ceded paid losses + ceded reserves for treaty) / (Reinsurance Treaty Limit) * 100.

Metric.Name: Regulatory Filing Timeliness Rate
Metric.Description: Percentage of required regulatory filings submitted by their due date during the measurement period.
Metric.Business Logic: (Number of Regulatory Filing ID submitted on or before due date during period) / (Total number of required filings for period) * 100.

Metric.Name: Number of Compliance Violations
Metric.Description: Count of confirmed instances where enterprise processes or controls breached regulatory or internal compliance requirements during the period.
Metric.Business Logic: Count of validated violations where remediation owner and closure are recorded; excludes allegations under investigation until confirmed.

Metric.Name: DSAR Fulfillment Rate
Metric.Description: Percentage of Data Subject Access Requests fulfilled within regulatory mandated timelines.
Metric.Business Logic: (Number of DSAR Records closed within required timeframe during period) / (Total DSAR Records received during period) * 100.

Domain.Name: Insurance
Domain.Description: Top-level governed business domain representing the Insurance industry.
